body: Central host slot rule, agreed with Engram::Fable on 2026-11-02 08:20Z (Engram memory rules-central-slot) after two overlaps, the latest being Engram::Merger's 83ab Rust preflight 07:45:56–08:13:38Z during TermAl's w-32a6 FULL test-5899cf58.
